Balaji Amines Limited, headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur – 413001, Maharashtra, India, is a prominent chemical manufacturing company specializing in the production of high-quality amines and allied chemical products. Established to cater to the growing demand for specialty chemicals across diverse industries, the company has carved a niche for itself through its technical expertise, innovation, and adherence to global standards. Situated in Solapur, a burgeoning industrial hub in India, Balaji Amines leverages its strategic location to ensure efficient domestic and international distribution, serving clients in sectors such as pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, polymers, coatings, and water treatment.  

The company’s product portfolio encompasses a wide range of aliphatic and aromatic amines, critical intermediates used in synthesizing life-saving drugs, advanced pesticides, surfactants, lubricants, and other high-performance materials. Equipped with state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and advanced R&D infrastructure, Balaji Amines prioritizes quality, sustainability, and operational excellence. Its dedicated team of scientists and engineers ensures product consistency while continuously innovating to meet evolving industry needs.  

Committed to environmental stewardship, the company adopts eco-friendly manufacturing processes and complies with stringent regulatory standards, including ISO certifications and international quality benchmarks. Balaji Amines Limited also emphasizes energy efficiency, waste reduction, and responsible sourcing, aligning its operations with global sustainability goals. As a trusted partner to clients worldwide, it balances commercial success with ethical practices and social responsibility. With its robust supply chain network and customer-centric approach, Balaji Amines stands as a benchmark of reliability and innovation in India’s chemical industry, poised to drive progress in specialized chemistry while contributing to regional economic growth.
